label: m4-cpu-t6-repack-rss
question: Why is llama-server peak RSS ~7 GiB for a 4.58 GiB Q4_K_M model with one slot?
method: llama-server -t 6 -c 2048 -np 1 -ngl 0, one 64-token translation request, peak RSS from /usr/bin/time -l
finding: Repacking keeps a second ~2.3 GiB copy of the weights: 2x faster prefill, no decode gain. On 8 GB devices both configurations must be reported.
